title: Ich möchte etwas ansprechen
desc: Twenty minutes, asked for two days in advance
setting: A small meeting room at two o'clock, and four sentences written down the night before.

options.en: I would like to raise something.
options.feedback: The sentence it starts with. He now knows this is the thing and not small talk.
Kind, and it makes the next sentence harder to say.
You asked on Tuesday and he is sitting here. Start.

options.es: Ja. Letzte Woche ist es zweimal passiert.
options.en: Yes. It happened twice last week.
options.feedback: A number and an example. That makes it a matter and not a quarrel.
Immer is a word about a person. He will defend himself and you will lose the point.

options.es: Ja, aber es ist nicht so schlimm.
options.en: Yes, but it is not that bad.
options.feedback: You have just taken it back. He will believe you and nothing changes.

steps.speaker: Simon
steps.es: Das tut mir leid. Ich rede zu viel, ich mache das bei allen.
steps.en: I am sorry. I talk too much, I do it to everybody.

options.feedback: Sachlich and true. He says it himself thirty seconds later, and it is better if he does.
Then it was not worth two days of not sleeping.

options.en: Yes, that is right, with everybody.
options.feedback: Generous, and it lets the actual thing go by.

steps.speaker: Simon
steps.es: Und wie machen wir es jetzt?
steps.en: And how do we do it now?

options.es: Ich möchte meine Sachen selber sagen.
options.en: I would like to say my own things myself.
options.feedback: The fourth sentence you wrote down. Plain, and it asks for one thing.
The same thing, aimed at him instead of at the situation.
You asked for the meeting. Bring the answer to that question with you.
